summary.en-US: Redirects Lemmy and PieFed posts, comments, communities and users on your home Lemmy instance

description.en-US:
Redirects Lemmy and PieFed posts, comments, communities and users from any server to your home Lemmy instance, where you are logged in and can vote, comment and subscribe at once.

**Features**

- Works past the login page of private Lemmy servers and of PieFed servers that hide their content from guests.
- Leaves other sites alone. It looks at the page itself and sends no request for a site that is not Lemmy or PieFed.
- Does not redirect when you come from your home instance. To open one page without a redirect, add #noredirect to its address.
- Needs no login data. Its requests carry no cookies.

**Setup**

After the installation, the settings page opens. Enter your home instance, for example sh.itjust.works. The home instance must be a Lemmy server.

Source code, privacy policy and help: https://github.com/ALERTua/lemmy-home-instance-redirector
